description: This Java class implements a factory for creating and managing RegistrationClient instances related to the Hono API. It handles connection management, caching of clients, and tenant timeout events within the Hono client's implementation package.

classes.name: RegistrationClientFactoryImpl
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing RegistrationClient instances, handling connection states and tenant-specific client caches.

methods.name: RegistrationClientFactoryImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the factory with a HonoConnection and an optional CacheProvider, setting up tenant timeout consumer.

methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.description: Handles disconnection events by clearing the registration client factory's state.

methods.name: getOrCreateRegistrationClient
methods.description: Returns a Future for a RegistrationClient associated with a specific tenant ID, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: removeRegistrationClient
methods.description: Removes a registration client associated with a given tenant ID from the cache.

methods.name: handleTenantTimeout
methods.description: Handles tenant timeout messages by closing and removing the relevant registration client.
